kultivator.screen.help.formasi_pola: Every formation is a pattern of ordinary blocks around a Formation Eye. The Codex on the Formasi tablet shows each pattern as layer slices with its bill of materials. Show Pattern (or /cultivate formasi pola <id> [utara|timur|selatan|barat] [minutes]) puts a hologram in the world: the current layer is strong, upper layers are faint, finished layers are green. Gold cubes are missing blocks, red crosses are wrong blocks, grey means the chunk is not loaded; the six nearest missing blocks show their name. Sneaking while looking at an eye shows its pattern for a moment. The hologram only reads blocks and never places any; it ends after its minutes, beyond 64 blocks, on a dimension change or with /cultivate formasi pola mati. Patterns marked 'faces true north' cannot be rotated. Killing arrays hurt only hostile mobs, within kill caps, and transport never crosses dimensions. Hidden nametags from concealment are cosmetic: the tab list and the locator bar still show players. Sources: A Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality (RMJ), Investiture of the Gods ch. 44-50 and 82, Desolate Era Book 8.
